description: This file defines a JavaScript module that includes an underscore utility wrapper, template configuration, Google Analytics setup, functions for URL handling, and a Learn class for dynamically loading and displaying project info and issues from GitHub.

classes.name: Learn
classes.description: A class for fetching and displaying project information and issues, with methods to append info to the DOM and fetch issue counts from GitHub.

methods.name: Learn
methods.description: Constructor for the Learn class, initializes with JSON data and configuration, sets up templates and framework info, and triggers fetching of issue count.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.append
methods.description: Creates and inserts an informational sidebar into the DOM, customizing links based on backend or local demo links.

methods.name: Learn.prototype.fetchIssueCount
methods.description: Fetches the number of open issues from GitHub API and updates the DOM accordingly.
